cl.title: AI Clone
cl.fromTwin: Create my AI Clone from my photos
cl.intro: Your AI Clone is a cartoon twin of you, with your height and weight.
cl.how: Take 6 guided photos. As you lose weight or get stronger, your clone changes with you.
cl.ruleTxt: Your photos and your clone stay only on this phone. They are never sold, never used for ads and never shown to anyone. You can delete them any time.
cl.clothes: Wear fitted clothes (like sportswear). No underwear or swimwear photos.
cl.consent: I agree to use my photos to create my clone. Only the front photos are sent once to the AI to read colors and proportions, and they are not saved there.
cl.notMed: Your clone is an illustration for motivation. It is not a medical measurement.

tip.faceFront: Look straight at the camera. Put your face inside the oval. Good light, no glasses.
tip.faceLeft: Turn your head a little to the left.
tip.faceRight: Turn your head a little to the right.
tip.bodyFront: Stand 2 meters away. Whole body inside the outline, arms a bit open.
tip.bodyBack: Turn your back to the camera.

cl.noCam: Camera permission needed. You can choose a photo instead.
cl.camErr: The photo could not be opened. Try again.
cl.review: Your photos (tap one to redo it)
cl.needFront: The front face and front body photos are needed.
cl.sendOnce: The 2 front photos are sent once to the AI and are not saved there. Everything else stays on your phone.
cl.noPerson: I could not see a clothed adult in the photos. Please try again with fitted clothes.
cl.localOnly: AI not available now: I made your clone with colors read on your phone.
cl.byAi: Made with AI from your photos
cl.morph: Each time you log your weight or a workout, your clone updates: slimmer when you lose weight, stronger when you train.
cl.delQ: Delete your 6 photos and your clone from this phone?
cl.nudge: Create your AI Clone: a twin of you that changes as you progress.

tu.title: Learn to use Angie
tu.sub: Short videos with voice and subtitles. Tap the big play button.

photo.s2: Take a photo of your plate or choose one.
photo.s3: Check the calories and tap Add.

voice.s1: Tap the microphone in the bottom bar.
voice.s2: Say what you ate, for example: rice with chicken.
voice.s3: Check the result and save it.

barcode.s2: Tap Scan with camera and point at the barcode.
barcode.s3: If it is not found, take a photo of the label.

coach.s2: Answer your goal, days and minutes.
coach.s3: Angie makes your plan and adjusts it each week.

plan.s2: See your meals for each day.
plan.s3: Change any meal you do not like.

gym.s2: Choose a routine for your level.
gym.s3: Follow the timer and the voice.

weight.s3: See your chart and your trend.

chef.s2: Write or photograph what you have in the fridge.

menu.s2: Take a photo of the menu.
menu.s3: Angie shows the best options for your goal.

datos.s2: Give your permission and take a photo of a receipt.
datos.s3: Earn points. Your health data is never sold.

security.s2: Create a PIN. Tap the eye to see it.
security.s3: Turn on fingerprint or Face ID.

clone.s1: Open AI Clone and check both boxes.
clone.s2: Take the 6 photos following the outline.
clone.s3: See your clone: before, now and goal.
